dedupe_keys.name: palestinian water authority water sector facts and figures water availability and per capita supply

description: The Palestinian Water Authority (PWA) publishes a water data page of facts and figures on the water and sanitation sector, based on PWA data for 2023. Read on 27 September 2026, it gives the quantity of water available in the northern governorates (West Bank), 221 million cubic metres, and in the southern governorates (Gaza Strip), 178.7 million cubic metres, each broken down by source, and the per capita daily water share across the governorates. The page notes that the Gaza quantities have fallen sharply since the war on the Gaza Strip. Coverage is the West Bank and the Gaza Strip. Access is online and free on the PWA website. Caveats: the figures are for 2023 and predate the destruction of water infrastructure in Gaza, the page is in Arabic, and two related PWA data pages (water resources data and a data request page) reset the connection from the cloud session. Simulation uses: supply by source and per capita figures as baseline inputs for water supply and humanitarian planning. Related records: JMP WASH database (data-who-unicef-jmp-wash-database) and AQUASTAT (data-fao-aquastat-main-database).
